description: This Java test source file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the ChangeLogDetectiveDatabase integration within the OpenMRS project. It tests methods related to Liquibase database version detection and update file retrieval.

classes.name: ChangeLogDetectiveDatabaseIT
classes.description: JUnit 5 test class for testing Liquibase snapshot and update logic in OpenMRS using ChangeLogDetective.

methods.name: shouldGetInitialLiquibaseSnapshotVersion
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the initial Liquibase snapshot version after database initialization.

methods.name: shouldReturnDefaultSnapshotVersion
methods.description: Tests that the default snapshot version is returned if none is set.

methods.name: shouldGetUnrunLiquibaseUpdateFileNames
methods.description: Tests retrieval of pending Liquibase update files greater than a specified version.
